BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.18, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 1a.+]

[+Commercial vehicles keep right.+]

[+(a) On laned highways, as defined under subdivision 7, commercial vehicles must not drive in the leftmost lane except to: +]

[+(1) overtake or pass another vehicle under subdivision 1, clause (1); or +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; prohibiting commercial vehicles from driving in the left lane; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.18, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 169.18, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 1a.

Commercial vehicles keep right.

(a) On laned highways, as defined under subdivision 7, commercial vehicles must not drive in the leftmost lane except to:

(1) overtake or pass another vehicle under subdivision 1, clause (1); or

(2) move over for vehicles under subdivisions 11 and 11a.

(b) Violation of this subdivision is a petty misdemeanor.
